definitions.explanation: The opening instrumental section of a song, before the singing begins. A clipping of English "introduction," used almost exclusively of music.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧イントロ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: This song has a long intro.

examples.japanese: イントロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{曲名|きょくめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I could tell the song's title just from hearing the intro.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧で、イントロ⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{曲名|きょくめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧⟦クイズ→クイズ：10804_kuizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: A quiz where you guess the song title from the intro alone is popular on TV shows.

notes:
A casual, everyday music word, shortened from イントロダクション (introduction). It refers specifically to the opening of a song.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- イントロ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: to have a long intro
- イントロ⟦クイズ→クイズ：10804_kuizu⟧: an intro quiz (guess the song from its opening)
- イントロ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: the intro plays

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前奏|ぜんそう}: prelude/intro — the more formal Japanese term for the same opening section
- ⟦サビ→サビ：22298_sabi⟧: the hook/chorus — the catchiest, climactic part of the song, not the opening
